title: Thinking on How LLMs (& GenAI!) have Changed Our Thinking
summary: Kahran and Divya record an impromptu conversation about how using LLMs has changed how they think and what they look up. Examples range from finding the word 'en abeyance' to redesigning their phone grip ergonomically to wandering through the etymology of 'kid' via thieves' cant — and the bigger pattern that knowledge feels accessible now because it's a two-way conversation, the way a great librarian once was.

intents.display: to think about how using AI changes the way you think
